Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District is seeking to purchase 50,000 Student Tablets under bid number JA-207652. The final bid deadline is July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CDT, following a pre‑bid meeting on June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CDT. Proposals must be submitted online through the iSupplier portal or as one original hard‑copy sealed envelope; fax or email submissions are not accepted. The contract will be a 3‑year initial term with up to two 1‑year extensions, not to exceed five years, and requires white‑glove deployment services and a minimum 3‑year warranty for the tablets. Vendors must provide the required inter‑local agreement rider, consent form, and any additional documentation such as the Form 1295 Certificate of Interested Parties, and note that no bid bond is specified and the delivery date is not listed.
